title: chat-pins/1.0/unpin
description: Unpins a message for everyone in the conversation, whoever pinned it. Idempotent; per target, the later of a pin and an unpin stands.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender; the same id goes to every member of a group.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

pthid.description: In a group conversation, the group's id. Absent in a pair.

thid.description: The target's thread id, if the target is in a thread (chat-threads/1.0). Otherwise absent.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Of the pins and unpins of one target, the one with the latest value stands; on a tie, the unpin.

expires_time.description: UTC epoch seconds; the target's expiry, when it has one (disappearing-messages/1.0).

id.description: The id of the message referred to. Compared case-insensitively.

author.description: The DID that sent it, as the referring party knows it (its current DID or one it rotated away from).

target.description: The message unpinned, in the same conversation. A message reference; a snippet is not used here.
